title: Business Idioms
completion_message: ¡Fantástico! Los modismos (idioms) hacen que tu inglés suene mucho más natural y avanzado en un entorno profesional.

parts.visual:
Trabajo y reuniones: 
- Get down to business (Ir al grano / Empezar a trabajar seriamente). 
- Think outside the box (Pensar de forma creativa / fuera de lo convencional). 
- Learn the ropes (Aprender cómo se hacen las cosas / Aprender las cuerdas). 
Ej: Enough small talk, let's get down to business.
parts.audio: Work and meetings. Get down to business means to stop talking and start working seriously. Think outside the box means to think creatively. Learn the ropes means to learn how to do a new job. For example: Enough small talk, let's get down to business.

parts.visual:
Situaciones y control: 
- Be on the same page (Estar de acuerdo / En la misma sintonía). 
- Touch base (Ponerse en contacto / Hablar brevemente). 
- Call it a day (Dar por terminado el día de trabajo). 
Ej: It's 6 PM. Let's call it a day and touch base tomorrow.
parts.audio: Situations and control. Be on the same page means to understand each other and agree. Touch base means to contact someone briefly. Call it a day means to stop working for the day. For example: It's 6 PM. Let's call it a day and touch base tomorrow.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el modismo de negocios correcto.

questions.question: Enough small talk. Let's get down to ____. (Ir al grano / Empezar a trabajar).
questions.explanation: Get down to business = ir al grano, empezar lo serio.

questions.question: We need to find a creative solution. We must think outside the ____. (Pensar fuera de lo convencional).
questions.explanation: Think outside the box = pensar de forma creativa o diferente.

questions.question: He is new here. He is still learning the ____. (Aprendiendo cómo se hacen las cosas).
questions.explanation: Learn the ropes = aprender a hacer un trabajo (aprender 'las cuerdas').

questions.question: Before we sign, I want to make sure we are on the same ____. (En la misma sintonía / De acuerdo).
questions.explanation: Be on the same page = estar de acuerdo, entender lo mismo.

questions.question: I will ____ base with you next week to discuss the project. (Ponerme en contacto brevemente).
questions.explanation: Touch base = contactar o reunirse brevemente para actualizarse.

questions.question: It's 7:00 PM and we are tired. Let's ____ it a day. (Terminar por hoy).
questions.explanation: Call it a day = dar por terminado el trabajo del día.

questions.question: We need to keep an ____ on our competitors. (Vigilar / Estar atentos).
questions.explanation: Keep an eye on = vigilar, echar un ojo.

questions.question: To start a business from ____ means starting with nothing. (Desde cero).
questions.explanation: Start from scratch = empezar desde cero.

questions.question: We have to cut ____ to save money. (Reducir gastos/esquinas).
questions.explanation: Cut corners = tomar atajos, hacer las cosas más baratas (a veces perdiendo calidad).

questions.question: This new technology is a game ____. It will revolutionize the industry. (Algo que cambia las reglas del juego).
questions.explanation: Game changer = algo que cambia las reglas del juego.

questions.question: I have a lot on my ____ right now. I'm very busy. (Tener mucho trabajo/plato lleno).
questions.explanation: Have a lot on my plate = tener mucho que hacer, estar muy ocupado.

questions.question: She always goes the extra ____ for her clients. (Da un esfuerzo extra / La milla extra).
questions.explanation: Go the extra mile = hacer un esfuerzo adicional al requerido.

questions.question: We need to hit the ground ____ with this new project. (Empezar a trabajar rápido y con energía).
questions.explanation: Hit the ground running = empezar un proyecto a toda velocidad y con éxito.

questions.question: By the ____ of thumb, you should save 20% of your salary. (Como regla general).
questions.explanation: Rule of thumb = regla general, principio básico basado en la experiencia.

questions.question: The ball is in your ____ now. You have to make the decision. (La pelota está en tu cancha).
questions.explanation: The ball is in your court = es tu turno de actuar o decidir.

questions.question: Let's bring him up to ____ on the project. (Ponerlo al día / A la velocidad).
questions.explanation: Bring someone up to speed = poner a alguien al día o al corriente de la situación.

questions.question: We need to read between the ____ to understand what the client really wants. (Leer entre líneas).
questions.explanation: Read between the lines = leer entre líneas (entender el significado oculto).

questions.question: It's a win-____ situation for both companies. (Ganar-ganar).
questions.explanation: Win-win situation = situación donde todos ganan.

questions.question: They offered him a very low salary. It was a ____ figure. (Una cifra muy baja de forma insultante).
questions.explanation: Lowball figure = una oferta engañosamente baja. (Ballpark figure = cifra aproximada).

questions.question: Can you give me a ____ figure of the cost? (Una cifra aproximada).
questions.explanation: Ballpark figure = un estimado o cifra aproximada.
